text: Good evening ma, sorry to disturb you at this hour. My grandson is 2 years, his temperature is 39.6. He has been teething, dribbling and chewing everything, one cheek is red. But tonight he started shaking, his whole body was jerking and his eyes rolled up. He has never done this before in his life. Now I notice he will not bend his head forward at all, I tried to make him look down at his tummy and he refused, the neck is stiff like that. Please I am so sorry for bothering you but I am very worried, what should I do
